verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for a product with a public developer API surface like Outlook/Microsoft Graph, so the axis applies. However, the probes found no llms.txt (404), no markdown versions of the docs pages (404), and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path (404). The cited docs are ordinary human-oriented Graph API references with nothing designed for agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
